commit.summary: Spec 39 step 4a, the first of three parts of step 4. Every battle now has a native `BodyField` and native unit store under either engine (your call). That lets the scrum's seek, walk, facing and blows, which already ran in Rust on the field (Decision 129), lose their GDScript twins. `UnitStoreGd` is gone too. `BREACH_NATIVE` now picks only body parting's engine, which is the last pass with a twin. ScrumContest and ScrumReach are now views over the crate's new `contest.rs` and `reach.rs` (the `ScrumRules` binding, shared through `CrateScrum`).
commit.title: refactor(sim): the per-unit scrum in the crate (spec 39 step 4a)
